{"script":"rm -rf temp_var_count
mkdir temp_var_count
find /var 2>/dev/null > temp_var_count/var_listing.raw
sed 's|//|/|g' temp_var_count/var_listing.raw > temp_var_count/all_paths.txt

> temp_var_count/regular_files.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  if [ -f "$p" ] && [ ! -L "$p" ]; then
    echo "$p" >> temp_var_count/regular_files.txt
  fi
done < temp_var_count/all_paths.txt

> temp_var_count/symlink_resolution.txt
find /var -type l 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r l; do
  target=$(readlink -m "$l")
  if [ ! -e "$target" ]; then
    status="broken"
  elif [[ "$target" == /var/* ]]; then
    status="inside /var"
  else
    status="outside /var"
  fi
  echo "$l -> $target ($status)" >> temp_var_count/symlink_resolution.txt
done

> temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt
xargs -d '\n' stat -c "%d:%i %n" < temp_var_count/regular_files.txt 2>/dev/null | awk '!seen[$1]++ {print $2}' > temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt

> temp_var_count/missing_or_inaccessible.log
> temp_var_count/dedup_files_verified.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  if [ -r "$p" ]; then
    echo "$p" >> temp_var_count/dedup_files_verified.txt
  else
    echo "$p" >> temp_var_count/missing_or_inaccessible.log
  fi
done < temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt
mv temp_var_count/dedup_files_verified.txt temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt

{
  echo "Timestamp: $(date)"
  echo "Steps: 1. raw listing 2. normalize paths 3. filter regular files 4. resolve symlinks 5. dedup by device/inode 6. verify access"
  md5sum temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt
} > temp_var_count/audit_metadata.txt

cp temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt temp_var_count/final_input_for_count.txt
wc -l < temp_var_count/final_input_for_count.txt"}
